claim: EV-0041 binds EV-0040 to the final clean gem5 and self-amdgpu-runtime child identities and the CP-0016 prepare journal. It proves only the host-native functional parity/state adapter and HSACO metadata probe boundary; it does not claim PT_LOAD mapping, AQL or GPU execution, Triton end-to-end execution, hardware, timing, or performance.
command_argv:
set -eu
test -z "$(git -C projects/gem5 status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
test -z "$(git -C projects/self-amdgpu-runtime status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
printf '%s\n' 'gem5=clean'
printf '%s\n' 'self-amdgpu-runtime=clean'

import json,subprocess
j=json.load(open(".git/amdgpu-sim/txn/CP-0016.json"))
assert j["phase"]=="prepare"
expected={"gem5":("d69dee63c79a9784d5fbccbd6740a300f986d6ed","85ba92ca91589b6cf38c417a27649212ea5fcb25"),"self-amdgpu-runtime":("7797360ea04e9c3576c5cc16cf829427e96d3d70","64602386f81d7d27a555f1473b01f051b30c2276")}
assert set(j["expected_children"])==set(expected)
rows=[]
for name,(head,tree) in expected.items():
 p=j["expected_children"][name]["path"]
 assert j["expected_children"][name]["head"]==head and j["expected_children"][name]["tree"]==tree
 actual_head=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",p,"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
 actual_tree=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",p,"rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"],text=True).strip()
 status=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",p,"status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all"],text=True)
 assert (actual_head,actual_tree,status)==(head,tree,"")
 rows.append(f"{name} head={head} tree={tree} clean")
print("phase=prepare expected_children exact; "+"; ".join(rows))

import hashlib
p="state/evidence/EV-0040.json"
h=hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()
assert h=="f775b483fa49bcf1cd6b8bd81816741ad45f4cab62606ff7259d229340f30786", h
print("EV-0040="+h)

command_results.result: The CP-0016 journal and both participant repositories resolve to the final clean child identities.
